summary.scope: Evidence-supported GraL-only subset: 11 conventional quasars and 5 explicitly labelled special AGN/radio sources. Existing classifications and duplicate rows are retained. This is not a completeness certification.
summary.images: No new illustrations added; blank survey fields do not indicate absent survey coverage.

record.name: A2744-QSO1
record.note: Triply lensed, dust-reddened broad-line AGN / little red dot behind Abell 2744. Initial AGN interpretation was tentative; later NIRSpec spectra confirm it.
record.candidate report:
Furtak et al. 2023; candidate AGN; preprint 2022-12-20.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.10531
record.confirmation report:
Furtak et al. 2024; JWST broad Balmer lines.
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07184-8
record.discovery review: Lens evidence checked. Astrometry: GraL X, component A. Maximum image separation from GraL X.
